# Third-party material

- Bundled game files in `story/`: see [story notices and setup](../story/README.md).
  These files are excluded from the project's Apache 2.0 license.
- `picorv32.v`: unmodified from https://github.com/YosysHQ/picorv32,
  raw `main` retrieved 2026-11-02. License: `PICORV32_COPYING` (ISC).
- `DEJAVU_COPYRIGHT`: installed DejaVu font license, applicable to generated
  `assets/font.hex` derived from DejaVu Sans Mono.
- The user's adjacent `../hdmi_out` design provided the original HDMI serializer,
  PLL settings, TMDS encoder, constraints and TMDS test. Text console is new.
